about_pullquote: I started this because Nottingham deserves an electrician who turns up on time, does the job right, and doesn't fleece you.
about_para_1: Powerhouse Electrical was founded in 2006 on the back of simple frustration: too many cowboys, too many hidden charges, too many repeat visits. We built the business to be different — responsive, honest, and good at what we do. Today, we're Nottingham's go-to for everything from emergency callouts to complete rewires, and we've earned the trust of hundreds of homeowners and businesses across the city.
about_para_2: Our reputation comes from showing up when we say we will, charging what we quote, and finishing the job properly. We're NICEIC registered, fully insured, and we never use underqualified staff or cut corners. When you call Powerhouse, you get experienced electricians who take pride in their work — and customers keep coming back because of it.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called them at 11pm with no power in half the house. Guy was here by midnight, found a dodgy connection in the consumer unit, and had us back on by 12:45. Charged exactly what he'd quoted on the phone. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Got three quotes for a full rewire. Powerhouse was in the middle price-wise but their timeline was realistic and they didn't try to upsell us on stuff we didn't need. Took a week, no mess, and the paperwork was all sorted. Would use them again.
reviews.author: Jennifer L.

reviews.text: Our old fuse box kept tripping out. Called on a Friday and they came out Saturday morning. Replaced the whole thing, very professional, and didn't disappear after the job — sorted the paperwork the same day. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David K.
